drawing_notes.raw_text: 1. FOR SYMBOLS AND ABBREVIATIONS REFER TO ES.D.10.

extracted_rule.subject: symbols and abbreviations
extracted_rule.rule: Refer to ES.D.10.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 2. ALL DRAWINGS ARE PREPARED IN COMPLIANCE WITH COMPANY ENGINEERING STANDARD CORP-ENG-STD-018 REV. 01 (DRAUGHTING), CORP-ENG-STD-021 REV. 01 (ENGINEERING DATA CODING SYSTEM), ES.0.07.0028 REV.D (TAG NUMBERING AND EQUIPMENT IDENTIFIERS), 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001 (STANDARD SYMBOLS MULTI-DISCIPLINE).

extracted_rule.subject: all drawings preparation
extracted_rule.rule: All drawings must be prepared in compliance with company engineering standards: CORP-ENG-STD-018 REV. 01 (Draughting), CORP-ENG-STD-021 REV. 01 (Engineering Data Coding System), ES.0.07.0028 REV.D (Tag Numbering and Equipment Identifiers), and 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001 (Standard Symbols Multi-Discipline).

drawing_notes.raw_text: 3. COMPRESSORS ARE VARIABLE SPEED MOTOR DRIVEN. NEW MOTOR (COMPLETE WITH VSD SYSTEM) SHALL BE PROVIDED.

extracted_rule.subject: compressors
extracted_rule.rule: Compressors are variable speed motor driven. A new motor (complete with VSD system) must be provided.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 4. EXISTING ETHANE COMPRESSOR SHALL BE MODIFIED FOR NEW PROCESS CONDITIONS DEFINED IN THE PROCESS DATASHEET. ADEQUACY OF ALL EXISTING ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT SUCH AS SUCTION & DISCHARGE K.O. DRUMS, DISCHARGE GAS COOLER, ANTI-SURGE CONTROL VALVES, AUXILIARIES AND OTHER AS APPLICABLE HAS BEEN VERIFIED BY OEM HITACHI.

extracted_rule.subject: existing ethane compressor and associated equipment
extracted_rule.rule: The existing ethane compressor must be modified for new process conditions defined in the process datasheet. Adequacy of all existing associated equipment (suction & discharge K.O. drums, discharge gas cooler, anti-surge control valves, auxiliaries, and other applicable items) has been verified by OEM Hitachi.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 5. LOAD SHARING SHALL BE PROVIDED BY ETHANE COMPRESSOR VENDOR TO SHARE FLOW RATE EQUALLY ACROSS BOTH OPERATING UNITS.

extracted_rule.subject: ethane compressor load sharing
extracted_rule.rule: Load sharing must be provided by the ethane compressor vendor to share flow rate equally across both operating units.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 6. EXISTING DISCHARGE GAS COOLER E-V-201 WAS PART OF THIS P&ID, NOW IT IS SHOWN IN NEW DWG. NO. 4224-MGDV-6-50-2004-002 ALONG WITH NEW DISCHARGE GAS COOLER.

extracted_rule.subject: existing discharge gas cooler E-V-201
extracted_rule.rule: The existing discharge gas cooler E-V-201, previously part of this P&ID, is now shown in new drawing no. 4224-MGDV-6-50-2004-002, along with a new discharge gas cooler.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 7. EXISTING RECYCLE ANTI-SURGE VALVE (INCLUDING ALL ITS ACCESSORIES SUCH AS POSITIONER, ACTUATOR, LIMIT SWITCHES, POSITION TRANSMITTER, VOLUME TANKS AS APPLICABLE) SHALL BE REPLACED WITH NEW BY HITACHI.

extracted_rule.subject: existing recycle anti-surge valve and accessories
extracted_rule.rule: The existing recycle anti-surge valve (including all its accessories: positioner, actuator, limit switches, position transmitter, and applicable volume tanks) must be replaced with new by Hitachi.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 8. EXISTING (V-RO-213) SHALL BE DEMOLISHED & REPLACED WITH NEW FLOW ELEMENT (V-FE-224) BY EPIC CONTRACTOR AND FLOW TRANSMITTER (FIT) SHALL BE RETAINED.

extracted_rule.subject: existing V-RO-213 and flow transmitter
extracted_rule.rule: Existing V-RO-213 must be demolished and replaced with a new flow element (V-FE-224) by Epic Contractor. The flow transmitter (FIT) must be retained.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 9. ARRIVAL TEMPERATURE SIGNAL WILL BE USED BY ETHANE COMPRESSOR CONTROL SYSTEM FOR CALCULATING MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE ARRIVAL PRESSURE BASED ON ETHANE FLUID DEW POINT. THE CALCULATION FUNCTION BLOCK TO COMPUTE THE MAXIMUM PRESSURE SET POINT FOR THE ETHANE COMPRESSOR HIGH PRESSURE OVERRIDE FUNCTION SHALL BE PART OF THE ETHANE COMPRESSOR CONTROL SYSTEM. BASED ON EQUATION 1, DEFINED IN OPERATING & CONTROL PHILOSOPHY DOCUMENT NO. 4224-MGDTY-6-03-2001.

extracted_rule.subject: ethane compressor control system logic
extracted_rule.rule: The arrival temperature signal will be used by the ethane compressor control system to calculate the maximum allowable arrival pressure based on the ethane fluid dew point. The calculation function block to compute the maximum pressure set point for the ethane compressor high pressure override function must be part of the ethane compressor control system. This is based on Equation 1, as defined in Operating & Control Philosophy Document No. 4224-MGDTY-6-03-2001.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 10. THERMOWELL (TW), TEMPERATURE ELEMENT AND TEMPERATURE TRANSMITTER (TT) TO BE REPLACED. REFER ADEQUACY REPORT FOR THERMOWELL (4224-MGDTY-4-17-2001).

extracted_rule.subject: thermowell (TW), temperature element, and temperature transmitter (TT)
extracted_rule.rule: Thermowell (TW), temperature element, and temperature transmitter (TT) must be replaced. Refer to the adequacy report for thermowell (4224-MGDTY-4-17-2001).

drawing_notes.raw_text: 11. EXISTING SUCTION K.O. DRUM INTERNALS VANE PACK (VENDOR FORAIN) SHALL BE REPLACED WITH NEW BY HITACHI.

extracted_rule.subject: existing suction K.O. drum internals vane pack
extracted_rule.rule: The existing suction K.O. drum internals vane pack (vendor Forain) must be replaced with new by Hitachi.

drawing_notes.raw_text: A. FOR STANDARD P&ID SYMBOLS, EQUIPMENT SYMBOLS AND DESCRIPTION REFER TO STANDARD DRAWING ES.0.07.0100 REV.B

extracted_rule.subject: standard P&ID symbols, equipment symbols and description
extracted_rule.rule: Refer to standard drawing ES.0.07.0100 REV.B.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
12. COMPRESSOR UNIT CONTROL PANEL (UCP) BEING REPLACED UNDER THIS PROJECT. ALL EXISTING
INSTRUMENT CONNECTIVITIES, FUNCTIONS, INTERLOCKS, ALARMS, SHALL BE CONFIGURED IN THE
NEWLY SUPPLY PLC BASED UCP. ALL SIGNALS IN THE UCP SHALL ALSO BE AVAILABLE IN THE
EXISTING GDS SCADA INLINE WITH EXISTING PHILOSOPHY.

extracted_rule.subject: Compressor Unit Control Panel (UCP)
extracted_rule.rule: The Compressor Unit Control Panel (UCP) is being replaced under this project. All existing instrument connectivities, functions, interlocks, and alarms shall be configured in the newly supplied PLC-based UCP. All signals in the UCP shall also be available in the existing GDS SCADA in line with existing philosophy.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
13. NEW SAFETY RELIEF VALVE SHALL BE PROVIDED TO SAFEGUARD SYSTEM AGAINST OVERPRESSURE
(BLOCKED DISCHARGE CONDITION). ISOLATION VALVES SHALL BE PROVIDED WITH NEW PLATFORM FOR
OPERATION.

extracted_rule.subject: New Safety Relief Valve
extracted_rule.rule: A new safety relief valve shall be provided to safeguard the system against overpressure (blocked discharge condition). Isolation valves shall be provided with a new platform for operation.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 14. COMMON WARE HOUSE SPARE RV SHALL BE PROVIDED (ONE NO. FOR 3 COMPRESSOR).

extracted_rule.subject: Common Ware House Spare RV
extracted_rule.rule: One common ware house spare RV shall be provided (one number) for 3 compressors.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 15. THERE IS NO INTERLOCKING FOR ISOLATION VALVE ON SINGLE RV.

extracted_rule.subject: Isolation Valve on Single RV
extracted_rule.rule: There is no interlocking for the isolation valve on a single RV.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 16. NEW PROPOSED MOTOR ENCLOSURE (ATEX, EX’P’ TYPE) REQUIRES INSTRUMENT AIR.

extracted_rule.subject: New Proposed Motor Enclosure
extracted_rule.rule: The new proposed motor enclosure (ATEX, Ex'P' type) requires instrument air.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
17. EXISTING RCI MODULE SHALL BE REMOVED FROM THE EXISTING UCP PANEL AND SHALL BE RE-USED
INSIDE THE NEW UCP PANEL.

extracted_rule.subject: Existing RCI Module
extracted_rule.rule: The existing RCI module shall be removed from the existing UCP panel and shall be re-used inside the new UCP panel.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 18. COMPRESSOR SUCTION ESD VALVE (V-ESDV-209) IS RETAINED.

extracted_rule.subject: Compressor Suction ESD Valve (V-ESDV-209)
extracted_rule.rule: The Compressor Suction ESD Valve (V-ESDV-209) is retained.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
19. ONE (COMMON FOR ALL THREE TRAINS) TEMPORARY SUCTION STRAINER SHALL BE SUPPLIED BY OEM
(MS. HITACHI). AFTER SUCCESSFULL COMMISSIONING, THE STRAINER SHALL BE REMOVED, AND REPLACED
WITH A FABRICATED SPOOL PIECE BY EPIC CONTRACTOR.

extracted_rule.subject: Temporary Suction Strainer
extracted_rule.rule: One temporary suction strainer (common for all three trains) shall be supplied by the OEM (MS. HITACHI). After successful commissioning, the strainer shall be removed and replaced with a fabricated spool piece by the EPIC contractor.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
20. COMPRESSOR LOWER DESIGN TEMPERATURE (—)29 DEGC, EXCEPT FOR DRY GAS SEAL O-RING, WHICH IS
0 DEGC. COMPRESSOR UPPER DESIGN TEMPERATURE 150 DEGC, HOWEVER, SINCE ASME PTC10 TYPE 2
TEST SHALL BE CONDUCTED, THEREFORE, COMPRESSOR CASING SHALL BE DESIGNED TO 170 DEGC
WHICH IS REQUIRED DUE TO THE USE OF CO2 AS TEST GAS. ULTIMATELY NAME PLATE RATING FOR THIS
UNIT USING ETHANE GAS IS 150 DEGC.

extracted_rule.subject: Compressor Design Temperatures
extracted_rule.rule: The compressor lower design temperature is -29 DEGC, except for the dry gas seal O-ring, which is 0 DEGC. The compressor upper design temperature is 150 DEGC. However, since ASME PTC10 Type 2 test shall be conducted, the compressor casing shall be designed to 170 DEGC, which is required due to the use of CO2 as test gas. Ultimately, the name plate rating for this unit using ethane gas is 150 DEGC.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
21. HIGH PERFORMANCE (CLASS—1) NON-RETURN VALVE (NON-SLAM TYPE), WITH LOW CRACK OPEN DP
SHALL BE SELECTED FOR THIS APPLICATION. (PURPOSE: AVOID REVERSE FLOW / SURGE ISSUES DURING
DYNAMIC SCENARIO OF COMPRESSOR TRIP).

extracted_rule.subject: Non-Return Valve
extracted_rule.rule: A high performance (Class-1) non-return valve (non-slam type), with low crack open DP, shall be selected for this application. Its purpose is to avoid reverse flow / surge issues during dynamic scenarios of compressor trip.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
22. EXISTING SUCTION & DISCHARGE COMPRESSOR INLET & OUTLET SPOOL SHALL BE DISMANTLED TO
FACILITATE COMPRESSOR MODIFICATION, AND THEN RE-INSTATED.

extracted_rule.subject: Compressor Inlet & Outlet Spool
extracted_rule.rule: Existing suction and discharge compressor inlet and outlet spool shall be dismantled to facilitate compressor modification, and then re-instated.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
23. SOFT HAND SWITCH SHALL BE CONFIGURED IN UCP HMI TO ENABLE/ DISABLE STATION S HIGH PRESSURE
CONTROLLER (%) WHICH IS REPEATED FROM LOAD SHARING PANEL.

extracted_rule.subject: Soft Hand Switch
extracted_rule.rule: A soft hand switch shall be configured in the UCP HMI to enable/disable Station's high pressure controller (%), which is repeated from the load sharing panel.

drawing_notes.raw_text:
24. RECLOSURE OF XV—202 (NORMAL SHUTDOWN DEPRESSURING VALVE) SHALL BE PERFORMED BY UCP, ONCE
V-PAL-214 IS OBTAINED (@ 18 barg) OR AFTER 20 MINUTES TIME DELAY FROM OPENING OF XV—202
WHICHEVER COMES FIRST. (NOTE: PAL-214 SHALL BE CONSIDERED AN EVENT, NOT ALARM).

extracted_rule.subject: Reclosure of XV-202
extracted_rule.rule: Reclosure of XV-202 (normal shutdown depressuring valve) shall be performed by UCP, once V-PAL-214 is obtained (@ 18 barg) or after 20 minutes time delay from opening of XV-202, whichever comes first. PAL-214 shall be considered an event, not an alarm.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 25. FOR INTERLOCK DETAILS, REFER TO SYMBOLS & LEGENDS DRAWING NO. 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001-003.

extracted_rule.subject: Interlock Details
extracted_rule.rule: For interlock details, refer to Symbols & Legends Drawing No. 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001-003.

extracted_rule.rule: Refers to drawing 4224-MGDV-6-50-2002-001.
